name: The Swamp
description: The Swamp is a large, foggy marsh of dense growth, south of the Border Zone and north of the South Wetlands, and it is easy to get lost there. No one person rules it: the Swampers share its villages with five gangs who deal in hashish, and the Hounds run the city of Shark and the village of Rot. The Red Sabres keep a hideout here and Swamp Ninjas patrol. Swamp raptors and blood spiders are common, and swamp turtles live here.
